name: kpi-dashboard
description: Runs the API (server) and the web app (web) together from the project root.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix web run build
